# Century Dam

Century Dam is a dam located in Malibu Creek State Park in the Santa Monica Mountains of Southern California.
History
In 1903, wealthy Angelenos belonging to Crags Country Club created the 50-foot-tall dam in order to make a seven-acre hunting and fishing lake, Century Lake, for their country club. The club went bankrupt in 1936, and in 1946, 20th Century Fox bought the lake and a big swath of the surrounding land to film movies. In 1968, Planet of the Apes used the lake for filming.
